name: Motivo
one_liner: Managed clinical supervision platform connecting pre-licensed therapists with 1,500+ vetted supervisors across all 50 states.
short_description: Motivo is a managed clinical supervision platform that connects pre-licensed mental health professionals with vetted supervisors for virtual supervision sessions.
long_description: Motivo is the leading managed clinical supervision platform for behavioral health organizations and pre-licensed therapists. The platform connects pre-licensed staff (associates, interns, trainees) with over 1,500 vetted clinical supervisors across all 50 states for virtual supervision sessions. Motivo handles everything: supervisor vetting, matching, scheduling, HIPAA-compliant video, documentation, and state board compliance. Individual supervision sessions run approximately $75/hour, with group supervision at $55-65/hour. Organizations can purchase custom packages to subsidize intern supervision. Motivo reduces the burden on senior clinicians by outsourcing supervision, saving $1,500-2,500 per therapist position in recruitment costs. The platform is particularly valuable for health plans, health systems, and digital behavioral health companies needing to scale their clinical workforce while maintaining compliance.
best_for: Pre-licensed therapists (associates, interns, trainees) seeking supervision
Behavioral health organizations wanting to outsource supervision
Health systems scaling clinical workforce with compliance
Digital health companies needing supervised clinicians
not_for: Those seeking peer consultation (this is formal supervision)

pricing.notes: Payment charged at time of each session. Free intro call to match with supervisor before billing begins. Organizations can subsidize supervision costs for their pre-licensed staff. Contact sales for enterprise pricing.

compliance.notes: HIPAA-compliant video platform with documentation that meets state board requirements.
